title: Container details

access.deniedDescription: Ask an administrator to grant container view permission

sort.title: Sort
sort.hint: Tap a field to sort; tap the current field again to switch ascending / descending

filter.title: Filters
filter.invalidRange: Enter valid numbers; the minimum cannot exceed the maximum
filter.showReadonlyOemPriceHint: Also show the server's read-only retail price in row details; not a filter

pageSizeHint: Changing this returns to page 1; your choice is remembered on this device

states.emptyHint: Adjust the search or filters and try again

edit.title: Edit row
edit.overrideConfirmMessage: This will overwrite {{count}} field(s) updated on the server. If the server changes again you will be asked to confirm again.

bulk.title: Bulk actions
bulk.scopeFiltered: Nothing selected: applies to the current filtered results ({{count}} rows)
bulk.submitContainerHint: Whole-container action; ignores selection and filters and asks for confirmation first

pushHq.confirmMessage: Send {{count}} selected row(s) to the HQ database (all updatable fields).

createProducts.title: Create new products
createProducts.warning: This will create product records for the {{count}} selected new product(s) and list them. This cannot be undone.
createProducts.syncToHq: Also update the HQ database after creating
createProducts.missingTitle: {{count}} new product(s) have a retail price of 0
createProducts.missingHint: The retail price must be greater than 0 to create a product. Set the price, then try again.
createProducts.running: Creating products, please keep this open…
createProducts.runningWithHq: Creating products and syncing HQ, please keep this open…

result.blockedNoDetails: There are no new products to create
result.blockedMissingPrice: Some new products have a retail price of 0. Blocked; nothing was created
result.creationFailed: The creation job failed; products were not created
result.creationNothing: The job finished but no products were created
result.creationError: The creation job could not be confirmed. Refresh the details to check the result before retrying

hq.unsentCreated: {{count}} created product(s) were not queued for HQ. Send them later from Bulk actions → Push selected to HQ
hq.syncDisabled: HQ sync was not selected and was skipped
hq.nothingCreated: Nothing was created, so nothing was sent to HQ
hq.noCandidates: Created products lack a product code or supplier item number and could not be sent to HQ
hq.pushBusy: Another HQ push is running, so this one was not sent automatically. Push manually later
hq.failed: Products were created, but syncing HQ failed. You can retry from Bulk actions
hq.error: Products were created, but syncing HQ hit an error. You can retry from Bulk actions

submitContainer.title: Submit container
submitContainer.scope: This submits the whole container {{container}}: every detail row, regardless of the current search, filters or selection.
submitContainer.scopeNote: Make sure the details have been checked before submitting.
submitContainer.scopeNoteWithRows: {{count}} detail rows. Make sure they have been checked before submitting.
submitContainer.running: Submitting the container, please keep this open…

result.error: Submitting hit an error and the job status is unknown. Refresh the details to check

align.missingCodes: No product code available to align
align.failed: Failed to align domestic product code
align.previewFailed: Failed to load the alignment preview
align.mergeIntro: The domestic product table already has a record with the Australian code {{local}}. Change code {{domestic}} in the domestic product and containers to the Australian code {{local}} and merge the old record into it?
align.mergeImpact: {{rows}} detail row(s) in {{containers}} container(s) will be re-pointed. Row prices and carton sizes are unchanged.
align.mergeNoDiff: The two records match; nothing to fill in.
align.mergeNote: The existing record wins; empty fields are filled from the old record, and the old record is marked deleted (recoverable).
align.renameIntro: Change code {{domestic}} in the domestic product and containers to the Australian code {{local}}?
